title: AI Coding Agent: Build Apps Through Chat | Replit

facts.fact: Replit states that its proprietary Agent testing system is 3x faster and 10x more cost effective than Computer Use Models (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: Our proprietary testing system is **3x faster and 10x more cost effective**than Computer Use Models.

facts.fact: A Replit customer, Preston Zeller of BatchData, said a developer would probably take about a week to build the app he prototyped with Replit (customer testimonial, not independently verified).
facts.quote: If I asked my developer to make this, it would probably take him a week.

facts.fact: Replit describes itself as an AI platform where users describe what they want in natural language and then create, launch, and grow apps, sites, tools, and businesses in one place.
facts.quote: Replit is the AI platform that helps you turn your ideas into real outcomes. Describe what you want in natural language, then create, launch, and grow apps, sites, tools, and businesses in one place.

facts.fact: Replit's page states that Replit Agent lets users tell the agent what to build, refine it through conversation, and launch a production-ready app from one workspace.
facts.quote: Tell Agent what you want to build, refine it through conversation, and launch a production-ready app from one workspace.

facts.fact: The Replit website footer shows a copyright notice of 2026 for Replit, Inc.
facts.quote: All rights reserved. Copyright © 2026 Replit, Inc.
